overall_goal: Fry the onions and potatoes together in the pan, adding oil as needed and removing burnt pieces.

goals.description: Add oil and chopped onions to the frying pan
goals.rationale: The person opens the oil can, pours oil into the pan, and then adds the chopped onions from the chopping board.

goals.description: Stir the mixture, split large potato chunks, and manage spills
goals.rationale: The person stirs the onions and potatoes, retrieves a spilled onion bit, catches a falling spatula, and splits a large potato chunk.

goals.description: Add more oil and continue stirring and splitting potatoes
goals.rationale: The person pours additional oil into the pan, stirs the contents, and splits more large potato chunks.

goals.description: Remove burnt potato chunks while stirring and splitting the remaining pieces
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly identifies and removes burnt potato chunks, placing them on a chopping board, while continuing to stir and split the rest.

goals.description: Perform final stirring of the potatoes and onions
goals.rationale: The person gives the mixture a final stir, taps the spatula to clean it, and sets it down.
